source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 5 to 9
source.evidenceText: Mike Nelson, XBOX Wire Editor October 2, 2026 · 7 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Gears of War: E-Day Pre-Order Xbox Game Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Gears of War: E-Day – October 6Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Experience the horror and brutality of Emergence Day. Fourteen years before the original Gears of War, join Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago in a gripping origin-story campaign as the Locust Horde first erupt from below, igniting a desperate fight for survival. Rally your squad and fight on in multiplayer with a reimagination of Gears’ iconic PvE mode, Horde Siege, or go head-to-head with a refined Versus PvP. Built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers the most immersive Gears yet. STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ Secret Mode ☆☆☆☆☆ 10 ★★★★★ Get it now STAR WARS: Galactic Racer – October 6 A ​​runs-based​​, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim of the ​​STAR WARS​​ galaxy.​​​​ The Empire’s grip on the galaxy has finally broken, and with its fall comes a new obsession: speed. As the New Republic struggles to rebuild, gambling, entertainment, and glory fuel a booming underground. Out of this chaos, the Galactic League is born: an unsanctioned racing circuit where syndicates sponsor pilots, fortunes are won and lost in seconds, and only the bold survive. No Force. No prophecy. Just skill, strategy, and the will to rise. KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III] SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. ☆☆☆☆☆ 17 ★★★★★ $74.99 Get it now KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III] – October 6XBOX Play Anywhere A value‑packed bundle featuring three collections: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-, KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC). Echo Weaver Akupara Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $19.99 Pre-order Echo Weaver – October 8Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop. Hidden Dogs Silesia Games Sp. z o.o. ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Hidden Dogs – October 7 Welcome to puppy village! Labby needs your help with a top-secret mission: creating a video game just for dogs (move over, cats!). Find 500+ hidden dogs and items scattered across 15 cozy, hand-drawn levels in the English countryside. Got stuck? Just blow the dog whistle! Keep finding pups to watch the map grow and come to life with moving planes, boats, and trains! Titanic Escape Simulator MagicProStudio ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Titanic Escape Simulator – October 7XBOX Play Anywhere You are a private investigator aboard the world’s most famous ocean liner. What begins as a routine voyage soon becomes something far darker: a suspicious death, hidden clues, locked rooms, restricted decks, and a mystery buried deep within the ship. Explore the Titanic before disaster strikes. Question passengers, search cabins, uncover secrets, and follow a trail that leads from the elegance of First Class to the shadowed lower decks below. But as the truth begins to surface, so does the danger. Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire JanduSoft ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire – October 7XBOX Play Anywhere An action-farming-roguelite set in Transylvania, the homeland of Dracula and his rebellious lastborn son, Voltaire. An epiphany results in a change of heart for the young vampire: abandoning blood in favor of a plant-based diet out of spite to prove to his father that neck-biting is not the only way for vampires to thrive. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival Saber Interactive Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 29 ★★★★★ $39.99 Pre-order Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival – October 8 Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Play the story of Aidan, who must use the power of a mysterious puzzle box – the Genesis Configuration – to help his girlfriend Sunny’s escape from the otherworldly hellscape of the Labyrinth. Wield the powers of the box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead and do battle with the horrific cult devoted to the Cenobites. Neon Abyss 2 Kepler Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Neon Abyss 2 – October 8XBOX Play Anywhere Dive deeper into the chaotic, beautifully pixelated Abyss with Neon Abyss 2! The action is faster, the stakes are higher, and the possibilities are endless in this cybermyth roguelike. With explosive run ‘n’ gun gameplay, diverse combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, Neon Abyss 2 delivers a dramatic, thrill-packed experience every time you enter. Deck of Haunts DANGEN Entertainment ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $19.99 $17.99 Pre-order Deck of Haunts – October 8 Deck of Haunts invites you to step into the eerie role of a malevolent Haunted House, where the walls whisper secrets and terror lurks around every corner. As the master of this cursed domain, your goal is to ensnare daring humans, play on their fears, and drain their very essence to expand your dark influence. Forever Ago Annapurna Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Forever Ago – October 8XBOX Play Anywhere Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you’ll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting characters, and even make some new friends. Gear.Club Unlimited 3 Nacon ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $49.99 Pre-order Gear.Club Unlimited 3 – October 8XBOX Play Anywhere For the first time in the series, you can now explore the asphalt roads of Japan as well as the French Mediterranean coast. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin. ◆ Cinematic pixel artWhat if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive.◆ A return to the familiarA classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more.◆ Strategic turn-based battlesExploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices.◆ FINAL FANTASY legendsBolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization.◆ Hours of side content to discoverThe world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon.Software description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):Pre-order Bonus: Magitek Airship & Squire Starter PackThis set contains an item that transforms your airship’s appearance into a magitek vessel, along with useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.Pack Contents: • Magitek Airship Passkey x1• Knight’s Greatsword x1• Chestplate of Preparation x1 (Increases EXP gained in battle by a certain amount)• Magicite Shard x1• Tent x3• Mist Potion x3*These bonuses are available only to customers who pre-order the product and are not available to customers who purchase the product after release. *After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. *The airship’s appearance can be changed by turning the Magitek Airship Passkey “ON” under the Items section of the main menu. Early Purchase Bonus: Squire Kickstart PackThis set contains useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.Pack Contents: • Blessed Cuirass x1 (Increase gil obtained by a certain amount)• Mist Ether x1*These bonuses are available only to customers who purchase the product by November 5, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. (PST). *After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. *This game is only compatible with Nintendo Switch™ 2. Please be aware that it cannot be played on Nintendo Switch™.*There is also a Nintendo Switch™ version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. *It is not possible to carry save data from the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version over to the Nintendo Switch™ version.*It is not possible to carry save data from the Nintendo Switch™ version over to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.About this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 8.8 GBNintendo Switch 2: 12.7 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
